recognize_zh: 臨床照片中，胸前與背部皮膚散在多處暗紅紫色、像瘀青的斑塊，胸部下方有一處較隆起的紫紅色結節，彼此大小不一、邊界模糊。這種「無痛、像瘀青的紫色皮膚病灶」是 BPDCN 最常見的初始表現，需要切片與 CD123/CD4/CD56 免疫染色確認。
features: Multiple bruise-like violaceous to dusky red patches scattered over the anterior chest and back
Larger raised plum-colored nodule on the lower chest
Lesions are variably sized, poorly demarcated and non-ulcerated
No overlying scale, crusting or vesicles visible
Clinical photograph only; no microscopic features assessable
describe_en: Clinical photographs of the anterior chest and back show multiple violaceous, bruise-like patches of varying size with a raised plum-colored nodule on the lower chest; the lesions are poorly demarcated and lack scale or ulceration. This pattern of disseminated purple cutaneous plaques and nodules is characteristic of skin involvement by blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm, but it is not specific on its own. Skin biopsy with immunohistochemistry (CD4, CD56, CD123, TCF4, TCL1) is required for diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Myeloid sarcoma/leukemia cutis can look identical clinically but on biopsy the cells express MPO, lysozyme or CD14/CD68 and lack the CD123/TCF4/TCL1 co-expression of BPDCN.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous lymphoma (e.g., DLBCL, leg type or NK/T-cell)
ddx.vs: Cutaneous lymphomas are distinguished by B- or T/NK-lineage markers on biopsy rather than by the gross appearance.
True ecchymoses evolve in color over days and vasculitis shows palpable purpura, whereas BPDCN lesions persist and enlarge into infiltrated nodules.
Kaposi sarcoma forms violaceous plaques too, but biopsy shows spindle-cell vascular slits that are HHV-8 (LANA-1) positive.
